# AxisUI

AxisUI is the modern **Angular 20** UI component library: signals-first, standalone, OnPush by default, zoneless-ready, styled with Tailwind v4 + OKLCH design tokens, and accessible to WCAG 2.2 AA with jest-axe assertions run against every component in CI. It is MIT licensed and install-as-you-go — pull in only the categories you use. npm scope: `@axisui-ng/*`.

## Install

- Everything (recommended): `ng add @axisui-ng/angular` — installs the umbrella package, wires Tailwind v4 + theme tokens, and gives you every component.
- Surgical (per category): `npm i @axisui-ng/<category>` — e.g. `npm i @axisui-ng/forms @axisui-ng/overlays`.
- Import a component from the umbrella (`@axisui-ng/angular`) or directly from its category package (`@axisui-ng/<category>`). Components are standalone — import the ones you need.

## Links

- Docs: https://axisui.dev
- Demo: https://axisui-demo.pages.dev
- Storybook: https://axisui-storybook.pages.dev
- Repo: https://github.com/Kishan009/UI-Library

## Components

### Primitives — `@axisui-ng/primitives`
Layout and text building blocks.
- aspect-ratio — maintain a fixed width-to-height ratio for its content
- box — generic styled container primitive
- cluster — inline group that wraps with consistent gaps
- grid — CSS grid layout primitive
- heading — semantic heading with typographic scale
- stack — vertical spacing primitive
- text — typographic text primitive

### Buttons — `@axisui-ng/buttons`
- button — primary action button with variants
- button-group — group related buttons together
- icon-button — compact icon-only button
- segmented — segmented single-select control
- toggle — two-state toggle button
- toggle-group — group of toggle buttons (single/multi select)

### Forms — `@axisui-ng/forms`
Form controls with reactive/template forms support.
- calendar — date calendar view
- checkbox — boolean checkbox control
- chip — chip / removable token element
- color — color picker input
- combobox — filterable select with typeahead
- date-picker — date selection input with popover calendar
- form-field — wrapper for label, hint, and error messaging
- input — text input
- input-mask — masked text input
- input-number — numeric input with stepper
- input-otp — one-time-passcode input
- radio — single radio control
- radio-group — grouped radio buttons
- rating — star / rating input
- select — dropdown select
- signature-pad — draw-to-sign canvas input
- slider — range slider
- switch — on/off switch
- tag-input — multi-value tag entry
- textarea — multi-line text input
- time — time picker input
- tree-select — hierarchical tree select
- upload — file upload control

### Data display — `@axisui-ng/data`
- accordion — vertically stacked expandable panels
- avatar — user avatar with fallback
- badge — small status / count badge
- card — content container card
- carousel — sliding content carousel
- collapsible — single expand/collapse region
- data-grid — feature-rich data grid (sorting, paging) — MIT
- statistic — formatted stat value display
- table — data table
- tabs — tabbed content
- timeline — chronological timeline

### Charts — `@axisui-ng/charts`
All MIT.
- chart — general-purpose chart component
- gauge — radial gauge
- heatmap — heatmap grid
- sparkline — compact inline trend chart

### Overlays — `@axisui-ng/overlays`
Floating and layered UI.
- context-menu — right-click context menu
- dialog — modal dialog
- hover-card — content card shown on hover
- menu — dropdown menu
- popover — anchored popover
- sheet — edge-anchored slide-in panel
- tooltip — hover/focus tooltip

### Navigation — `@axisui-ng/navigation`
- breadcrumb — breadcrumb trail
- command — command palette
- menubar — horizontal application menu bar
- navigation-menu — multi-level navigation menu
- pagination — page navigation control
- sidebar — collapsible app sidebar

### Feedback — `@axisui-ng/feedback`
- alert — inline alert / callout
- empty — empty-state placeholder
- progress — progress bar
- result — full-page result / status screen
- skeleton — loading skeleton placeholder
- spinner — loading spinner
- toast — transient toast notifications

### Layout — `@axisui-ng/layout`
- splitter — resizable split panes

### Misc — `@axisui-ng/misc`
- kbd — keyboard key display
- scroll-area — styled custom scroll container
- separator — visual divider

### Flow — `@axisui-ng/flow`
- hierarchy — hierarchy / org-chart flow view
- stepper — multi-step wizard

### Tree — `@axisui-ng/tree`
- tree — hierarchical tree view

### CDK — `@axisui-ng/cdk`
Low-level behavior primitives.
- virtual-scroll — virtual scrolling for large lists

### Blocks — `@axisui-ng/blocks`
Composed, page-level sections.
- auth-form — ready-made authentication form
- feature-grid — feature highlight grid
- pricing-table — pricing comparison table
- stat-row — row of headline statistics

### Icons — `@axisui-ng/icons`
- ax-icon — SVG icon component with a customizable registry

### Themes — `@axisui-ng/themes`
Theming utilities (OKLCH tokens, presets, dark mode).
- apply-theme — apply / switch theme tokens at runtime
- tokens — design token definitions

### Pro — `@axisui-ng/pro`
Only Theme Studio is commercial; everything above is MIT.
- theme-studio — visual theme / token editor (commercial)
